summary: Submitted a third bounded check for the appendEntries storage-failure branch. The harness uses real BootstrapCluster and NewRaft initialization, a real appendEntries handler call with a conflicting suffix, and an injected permitted StoreLogs failure after suffix deletion; background loops are suppressed through the existing skipStartup path. Local reproduction measured cached_last_index=3 and cached_last_term=2 against actual_last_index=1, with the conflicting entry unreadable and store_logs_failed=true; the monitor would produce a complete violating witness because the cached last log no longer matches the durable store before the handler returns. Preflight is valid. Formal retained execution and review remain required; the two prior findings remain confirmed.
